description: Creates a trail that specifies the settings for delivery of log data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
mitreAttackSubTechniques: T1562.008 - Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs

researchLinks.description: Blinding the Watchmen: Abusing Cloud Logging Services for Defense Evasion and Visibility

securityImplications: Attackers might use CreateTrail to redirect CloudTrail logs to a bucket or KMS key they control, both blinding the victim's own logging and giving the attacker continuous visibility into the account's activity.
